subject: Post-demo: token economics & $/1M benchmarking
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@retailai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: token economics & $/1M benchmarking

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for jumping on the demo today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so we can align pricing and next steps.

What we covered:
- RetailAI use case (categorization + product description generation + chat assist) and expected request mix.
- Preferred SLAs: sub-200ms p50 gen for chat, peak throughput for batch enrichment.
- Key ask for procurement: target unit economics ($/1M tokens) and monthly volume bands to size pilot and committed capacity.

To move forward we need two things from your side so we can model costs and propose a concrete pilot price:
1) Realistic monthly token volume (by workload type if possible: chat, generation, embeddings). Even a ballpark (e.g., 200M / 1B / 5B) helps.
2) Target $/1M tokens you expect or a budget range for inference costs.

Initial benchmark context (so you have something to react to):
- OpenAI public rates (model-dependent) typically imply ~$30–$100 / 1M tokens for higher-end chat-capable models; Anthropic similar order of magnitude depending on model.
- Public open-model hosts and self-hosted infra often drive unit costs lower (with tradeoffs) — roughly $8–$40 / 1M depending on quantization, batching, and instance selection.
- Redwood’s working pilot: for a mixed workload we usually land in $15–$45 / 1M tokens with options to reduce via caching, quantization, and Dedicated commitments. Committed (Reserved) capacity discounts can push effective $/1M materially lower for large volumes.

If you can share an export of recent usage (CSV) or a top-level monthly estimate, I’ll run a side-by-side cost table comparing: RetailAI current spend (if any) vs OpenAI/Anthropic public pricing vs Redwood pilot pricing at 3 volume bands.

Proposed next steps:
- You share rough monthly token bands + any budget guardrails (reply to this thread).
- I’ll produce a 1-page cost comparison + suggested pilot pricing and a short mutual action plan.
- If procurement wants, we can draft a short-term pilot SOW + DocuSign link for expedited start.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
attach: redwood_pricing_plan_v2.pdf (summary of pilot options)

Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics & $/1M benchmarking

Thanks Dylan — great walkthrough.

Quick answers:
- Monthly volumes (expected after quarter 2 ramp):
  * Chat assist (avg ~120 tokens/request, conversational): ~1.1B tokens/mo
  * Generation (product descriptions, avg 600 tokens): ~400M tokens/mo
  * Embeddings (re-ranks/bulk): ~150M tokens/mo
  => Total ~1.65B tokens/mo.

- Budget target: our finance/ops team is aiming for an inference spend in the $60k–$85k / month range for the above volumes. That implies a target blended $/1M tokens of roughly $36–$52. If Redwood can get us to the low end (~$36) for the pilot, procurement will be happy to fast-track.

I’ve attached a usage snapshot (historical sampling) for reference — the file contains request-level counts and some token metrics. Please keep this confidential.

Procurement will ask for a committed-capacity option if we move beyond pilot. CCing procurement email for the loop: procurement@retailai.com

— Alyssa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics & $/1M benchmarking

Alyssa — great, the numbers are super helpful. I ran a quick blended cost model (see inline) using the volumes you provided. I’ll follow up with a formatted PDF but wanted to give the topline here.

Assumptions: blended monthly tokens = 1.65B. Target pilot duration = 1 month (proof-of-value).

Scenario A — Public host reference (approx):
- OpenAI/Anthropic blended public list ~ $60 / 1M tokens (model & prompt/completion mix variability).
- Cost @ $60 / 1M => 1.65B tokens = (1,650 * $60) = $99,000 / month.

Scenario B — Redwood pilot (no commitment) conservative: $45 / 1M => 1,650 * $45 = $74,250 / month.

Scenario C — Redwood pilot (1–3mo pilot + light reserved commit): $36 / 1M => 1,650 * $36 = $59,400 / month (hits your lower budget band).

Notes on how we get to $36: batching + prefix caching for catalog generation, float16 quantization on select generator models, and routing lower-criticality embeddings to cost-optimized variants. We can also offer a short-term one-month pilot at $36 / 1M with a mutual action to evaluate QoQ and discuss Reserved tier pricing if latency/quality check out.

Proposed pilot terms (simple):
- Duration: 30 days
- Token cap: 2B tokens (to avoid overages during ramp).
- Price: $36 / 1M blended (applies to all token types during pilot).
- Success criteria: meet the chat latency SLO at p50 < 200ms and maintain generation quality within agreed eval set thresholds.
- Next step: if agreed, we’ll issue an SOW + DocuSign and provision a Dedicated pool with the pilot config.

Alyssa — if procurement prefers a short committed discount instead (e.g., 3 mo at a 10% prepay), we can draft both options. Marissa/Vivek — giving you the heads-up to review and weigh in on approval for the one-month promotional pilot price.
